title: Use Group I – additional provisions for parking requirement category
previewText: For permitted uses denoted with “*” for parking requirement category (PRC) in Section 42-111 (Use Group I – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply. For golf courses, the portion of such facility used for golf course club houses shall be classified as PRC B3. All other portions of a golf course shall not be subject to any parking requirements.
